propertyTypes.name: iso8601.date
propertyTypes.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), no time and no zone.

propertyTypes.name: iso8601.timestamp
propertyTypes.description: An ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 instant normalized to UTC.

propertyTypes.name: iso8601.duration
propertyTypes.description: An exact elapsed duration (ISO 8601 duration with fixed-length units).

propertyTypes.name: ucum.unit_code
propertyTypes.description: A unit of measure in the Unified Code for Units of Measure, case-sensitive form (kg, m/s, {each}).

propertyTypes.name: qudt.unit_id
propertyTypes.description: A QUDT unit, as its `unit:` local name (unit:KiloGM).

propertyTypes.name: gs1.gtin
propertyTypes.description: A GS1 Global Trade Item Number: GTIN-8, -12, -13, or -14, digits only (check digit not verified here).

propertyTypes.name: gs1.gln
propertyTypes.description: A GS1 Global Location Number: 13 digits (check digit not verified here).

propertyTypes.name: lei.lei
propertyTypes.description: An ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier: 18 alphanumerics and 2 check digits (checksum not verified here).

propertyTypes.name: unlocode.location_code
propertyTypes.description: A UN/LOCODE: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code and a 3-character location code.

propertyTypes.name: isco08.occupation_code
propertyTypes.description: An ISCO-08 occupation group code (major to unit group, 1 to 4 digits).
